claimText:
Add Learning Strategies 15, 25, and 35 to the Course Showcase under LDC, add Mental Health & Wellness under Wellness, and redeploy the showcase.

STAX acknowledgement:
STAX_ACK turn_2026-05-21T21-05-15-612Z_d542 3f702b45 32130679

Objective:
Add Learning Strategies 15, 25, and 35 to the Course Showcase under LDC, add Mental Health & Wellness under Wellness, and redeploy the showcase.

- .stax/task.md
- projects/course-showcase/workspace/index.html
- projects/course-showcase/workspace/main.js
- projects/course-showcase/workspace/assets/course-icons/learning-strategies.svg
- projects/course-showcase/workspace/assets/course-icons/mental-health-wellness.svg

Tests added:
- Updated projects/course-showcase/meta/showcase-ui.test.mjs to cover the LDC filter, Learning Strategies course URLs, and Mental Health & Wellness in Wellness.

Commands run:
- Read .stax/turn-contract.json, .stax/status.json, and .stax/next-codex-prompt.md.
- Read brainstorming and uncodixfy skill instructions because this task changes a frontend showcase surface.
- Inspected Course Showcase project metadata, workspace index, workspace registry, and showcase UI test.
- Updated the Course Showcase filters, registry, local icon assets, and test expectations.
- Ran node --test projects/course-showcase/meta/showcase-ui.test.mjs.
- Ran npm.cmd run validate:manifests -- --project course-showcase.
- Ran npm.cmd run verify -- --project course-showcase.
- Ran npm.cmd run typecheck.
- Ran npm.cmd run build:studio.
- Ran cmd.exe /c publish-course-showcase.bat.
- Ran live fetch checks for the Course Showcase root, main.js, and the two new SVG icon assets.
- Ran a Playwright live browser check for the LDC and Wellness filters.
- Removed the Course Showcase export firebase-debug.log generated by Firebase CLI.
- Updated docs/ops/ACTIVE_HANDOFF.md.

Command output summary with exit codes:
- STAX/context/skill reads: exit 0.
- Course Showcase file reads and searches: exit 0.
- showcase-ui.test.mjs: exit 0, 6 tests passed.
- validate:manifests course-showcase: exit 0, migrated metadata is valid.
- verify course-showcase: exit 0, metadata policy passed and missing local assets are none.
- typecheck: exit 0.
- build:studio: exit 0.
- publish-course-showcase.bat: exit 0; exported 25 files and deployed 20 hosted files to courseshowcasenextstep.
- Live fetch checks: exit 0; root, main.js, learning-strategies.svg, and mental-health-wellness.svg all returned HTTP 200.
- Playwright live browser check: exit 0; LDC showed Learning Strategies 15/25/35, Wellness showed Sports Wellness and Mental Health & Wellness, console errors 0.
- Cleanup command: exit 0.

What is verified:
- The live Course Showcase is deployed at https://courseshowcasenextstep.web.app.
- The Course Showcase has an LDC filter in both filter control locations.
- Learning Strategies 15, 25, and 35 are registered under category/area LDC with the live Firebase URLs.
- Mental Health & Wellness is registered under category/area Wellness with the live Firebase URL.
- The two new icon asset URLs load from the live deployment.
- The live browser check proves the LDC and Wellness filters expose the requested courses.

What is weak/provisional:
- I did not collect a STAX visual artifact; browser automation verified text/filter behavior directly.
- STAX status still contains stale unrelated command evidence from older tasks.

What is unverified:
- Final STAX acceptance after observer preflight; observer mode may remain Reject because of stale unrelated command evidence and proof-surface requirements.

Risks:
- Course Showcase categories are hardcoded in both index.html and main.js, so future category changes must update both.
- The Course Showcase export regenerated project deviation report timestamps and the workspace approval timestamp.
- The course image fields are not currently rendered in the rail, but the new SVG files are present for future rendering.

One next action:
Open https://courseshowcasenextstep.web.app and spot-check the LDC and Wellness filters visually.
